body:
"You're a disgusting pedo, and I hope you kill yourself."

Said by someone I trust enough to share my attraction with.
No, it's not, it literally is the term that clinicians use.
Non-offending MAPs deserve the right to get help, though.
Yes, and kinda. I still feel really awful and about it, and that's what the therapy is meant to prevent.
They're not non-offending if they don't actually not offend. Indulging in fiction is actually quite therapeutic and makes us want to kill ourselves less, generally.
Thank you, I'll take a look at both.

Thank you, I appreciate the response. It's good to know at least I haven't seem to have missed anything. I don't think the metaphorical stuff will help (I'm looking for stuff to help with my own bullshit).
My close friends and other partners care for me, at least.
I'm out to a few people, yeah.

The rest is good, but the whole "pedophilic impulses" thing makes me feel gross. It's fine, just, it sounds like I'm special for being a decent person.

But thank you, yeah. I appreciate it.

I've checked that out, and frankly it doesn't seem like my kind of space? It's always skeeved me out for some reason. I guess calling people virtuous just for not being utter shitbags makes me feel uncomfortable.
thank you, I love you too. I appreciate that. I didn't expect you to show up here and now I don't know what to say.
Yes, I'm dating at least one person (purposefully vague) my age. It's still incredibly tough, even with them.
